coaching.headline: Six fights, six wins, 23 kills to 3 — Dekker and Murdock won the same fight over and over until the map followed.
coaching.team: We never lost a fight: six clashes, six wins, and a 23-3 kill stream in 17 minutes. Dekker opened with first blood at 2.4 and finished 10/0/5, Murdock went 7/1/8 and Ikra 5/1/3 — the fed trio won the 8.3, 9.7 and 11.1 fights 3-0, 4-0 and 4-0. The one leak worth keeping from a stomp: of six won fights we cashed two — the 11.1 win bought Fangtooth at 11.2 and the 15.7 win bought a tower at 15.9, while the 2.4, 8.3, 9.7 and 12.9 wins turned into nothing on the map — so towers read only 2-1 at the end. When a fight ends 4-0, walk to a tower before resetting.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 11.1 teamfight at our Fangtooth — a 4-0 sweep with Fangtooth secured in the same window — put the game out of reach; they never won a single fight to answer it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 won the carry lane outright: 7/1/8 into Revenant, killing him at 8.5, 10.2 and 13.4, with the only death back at 2.5. One build note for a longer game — Imperator never came, and Lightning Hawk + Vanquisher + Imperator is the winning core on Murdock.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster held the favored offlane into Shinbi at 1/1/1, but the numbers were quiet — 5984 hero damage and one completed item (Orb Of Growth) by game end. The one death was the expensive kind: killed by Yin at 16 right after taking Shinbi down, and their only tower of the game fell at 16.5 off it. After a kill on the side lane, back off rather than hand the trade back.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs played the map, not the kill feed: Aurora took zero deaths, mitigated 11340 and led the team with 3728 objective damage. The trade-off showed in the fight log — Aurora appears in none of the six skirmishes and placed 2 wards. With every fight already winning, joining one of the 8.3 or 12.9 sweeps and cashing it into a tower is the next gear.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
ourKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

lead.title: Built to deal damage, not to soak it
lead.text: 800 hero damage a minute, more than 86% of Dekker support players this patch (26% of the team's), while mitigating less than 89% of them. The damage came from Crescelia, Tainted Scepter, Tranquility. Died 0 times.
lead.lesson: Dekker built for damage with little to soak it: focus Dekker first in fights and the damage leaves with them (a plan, not something the data shows happened).

loadout.name: Nothin' But Net
loadout.text: Stasis Bomb grants +25g and +2 Magical Power when it damages a Hero.

ability.name: Stasis Bomb
ability.what: Launch a bouncing bomb, dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+45%) magical damage and Stunning Enemies hit in a small area for 0.9s.

loadout.plain: Each Stasis Bomb that hits a hero gives gold and permanent magic power. Rewards landing long-range bombs often.

loadout.name: Aion
loadout.text: Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.
loadout.plain: Each cast adds mana regen and ability hits on heroes earn gold. Helps a low-farm support Dekker keep up on items.

loadout.name: Philosopher
loadout.text: Every 10s, generate 4 gold (faster with Ability Haste).
loadout.plain: Passive gold over time, faster with more ability cooldown reduction. Generic income, nothing special with Dekker's kit.

loadout.name: Arcane Resonance
loadout.text: Basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher progress 0.75% faster per 1 Mana Regen, up to 50%.
loadout.plain: More mana regeneration makes basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher gold tick faster. Pairs with Aion's regen stacks from casting.

loadout.name: Tranquility
loadout.text: Grace:  Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.
loadout.plain: Heals Dekker and nearby allies and briefly cuts damage they take. Use it mid-fight to save a teammate. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
